slides.title: Your Trusted Areca Nut Exporter
slides.copy: PT. Pakindo Impex Perkasa connects international buyers with Indonesian products through reliable sourcing, quality coordination, export documentation, and logistics support.

slides.title: Indonesian Products. Global Markets. Reliable Trade.
slides.copy: From supplier coordination to export documentation and shipment support, we help international buyers navigate sourcing from Indonesia with clarity and confidence.

slides.title: From Inquiry to International Shipment
slides.copy: A structured six-step process takes your requirements from initial inquiry through specification confirmation, documentation, and loading — all the way to shipment.

trust.heading: Reliable Trade Starts With the Right Partner
trust.copy: International sourcing requires more than finding a product. Buyers need clear specifications, dependable coordination, suitable packaging, accurate documentation, and shipment support. Pakindo Impex Perkasa works to make the process clearer and more efficient from inquiry to shipment.

cards.title: Reliable Product Sourcing
cards.copy: We coordinate product sourcing according to buyer requirements and agreed specifications.

cards.title: Quality-Focused Handling
cards.copy: Product requirements are reviewed carefully so buyers and suppliers have a clear understanding of quality expectations.

cards.title: Competitive Export Pricing
cards.copy: We work with suppliers and buyers to develop quotations that reflect product specifications, quantities, packaging, and shipping requirements.

cards.title: Export & Logistics Support
cards.copy: We coordinate documentation, packaging, loading, and shipment-related requirements throughout the export process.

about.heading: Your Indonesian Partner for Global Trade
about.copy1: PT. Pakindo Impex Perkasa is an Indonesian trading and export/import company focused on connecting Indonesian products with international buyers.
about.copy2: Our role can include sourcing, supplier coordination, product specification management, quality coordination, packaging, export documentation, and logistics support.

products.heading: Products from Indonesia
products.intro: Explore our product categories and contact us with your required specifications, quantity, packaging, and destination.

customSourcing.title: Custom Sourcing
customSourcing.copy: Looking for a specific Indonesian product? Send us your requirements and we can review sourcing possibilities.

steps.title: Send Your Requirements
steps.copy: Tell us the product, specification, quantity, packaging, destination, and other requirements.

steps.title: Product & Price Review
steps.copy: We review sourcing options and prepare a quotation based on the requested requirements.

steps.title: Specification Confirmation
steps.copy: Product quality, grade, packaging, quantity, and other commercial details are confirmed.

steps.title: Product Preparation
steps.copy: Product preparation and packaging are coordinated according to the agreed requirements.

steps.title: Documentation & Loading
steps.copy: Export documentation and shipment/loading arrangements are coordinated.

steps.title: International Shipment
steps.copy: The shipment proceeds according to the agreed trade and logistics arrangements.

buyerBenefits.heading: Built Around Your Requirements
buyerBenefits.copy: Every international order can have different requirements. Share the details of your market and shipment, and we can review the appropriate sourcing and export approach.

markets.heading: Serving International Buyer Requirements
markets.copy: We work with international buyers looking for Indonesian products and trade support. Share your destination country and requirements so we can review the appropriate sourcing and shipment options.

items.question: What products can I source from Indonesia?
items.answer: We offer selected Indonesian products and can review sourcing requirements for specific products. Please contact us with the product name, specification, quantity, and destination.

items.question: Can I request a specific product specification?
items.answer: Yes, buyers can submit their required specifications for review. Availability and sourcing feasibility should be confirmed for each inquiry.

items.question: What information do you need for a quotation?
items.answer: Include product name, quantity, quality/specification, packaging, destination port, preferred Incoterm, and any additional requirements.

items.question: Can you arrange samples?
items.answer: Sample availability depends on the product and order requirements. Contact us with your product request to confirm the available options.

items.question: What packaging options are available?
items.answer: Packaging depends on the product and buyer requirements. Contact us with your preferred packaging format so it can be reviewed.

items.question: Can you quote FOB, CFR, or CIF?
items.answer: Shipping terms depend on the shipment and destination. Please include your destination port and preferred Incoterm in your inquiry.

items.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.answer: MOQ depends on the product, grade, packaging, and shipment requirements. Please request a quotation for the specific product you need.

items.question: Which destination countries do you serve?
items.answer: We review inquiries from international buyers worldwide. Share your destination country and requirements so we can confirm feasibility.

finalCta.heading: Ready to Source from Indonesia?
finalCta.copy: Send us your product requirements, quantity, quality specifications, packaging preferences, and destination. Our team can review your inquiry and respond with the next steps.
